title: Remove old project artifacts with mole
summary: Use mole purge to remove old project artifacts and build files from your Mac, helping to free up space used by development projects.

steps.explain: Run mole purge to remove old project artifacts and build files.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo command for mole purge. You would need to rebuild your projects.

warnings: This command removes project artifacts and build files. Ensure you don't need these files for ongoing development.
